subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — data-retention & integration clarifying items
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Moore <danielle.moore@clearbridgemed.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — data-retention & integration clarifying items

Thanks again for taking time today, Danielle — great to meet and walk through the integration goals. Quick recap and the next steps so we all have alignment:

- Objective: get the SIG (and any CAIQ sections) started so your security team can review model/data posture and we can map evidence.
- Redwood ask: we’ll prefill the standard SIG columns for items we control; we need clarification on a few items that affect scope (data retention, PHI handling, and integration patterns).
- Next steps I mentioned: I’ll share our prefills + a short list of clarifying questions; Neha from security will lead the evidence map and timeline.

Clarifying questions we need from ClearBridge to scope the SIG properly (please respond inline):
1) Data types & PHI: Will ClearBridge be sending any protected health information (PHI) to Redwood via the API, or will PHI be kept on your side and only non-PHI text is sent? If PHI is sent, do you require a signed BAA and are there specific field-level restrictions?
2) Retention window: What is the max retention ClearBridge requires for logs, transcripts, and generated outputs? (examples: 30 days, 90 days, indefinite).
3) Integration pattern: Are you planning direct API calls from your app to Redwood, or a batch SFTP/ingest flow? If SFTP/batch, who will host the SFTP and what encryption/KMS expectations exist?
4) Compliance baseline: Aside from HIPAA, do you need GDPR data-subject controls for EU users or any regional isolation?
5) Timeline & reviewers: Who on your security/compliance team will be the primary reviewer and what target date do you have for the SIG deliverable?

I've attached our SIG prefill template and the call recording for reference. Once we get your answers we’ll prefill the spreadsheet and flag items where we need evidence uploads.

Thanks — I’ve put a short proposed timeline in the attached MAP (can adjust).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Jasmine.Liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx (spreadsheet - prefills), call-recording-20261114.mp3 (audio)

From: Danielle Moore <danielle.moore@clearbridgemed.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: techops@clearbridgemed.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — data-retention & integration clarifying items

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below, and I’ve copied our Tech Ops inbox for follow-up and to send the prefills where applicable.

1) PHI: We will likely send patient identifiers and clinical notes for summarization in the pilot (so yes, PHI). We absolutely require a signed BAA for any PHI processing.
2) Retention: For the pilot we’d prefer 90 days for logs/transcripts and 365 days for generated outputs, but need to understand default Redwood retention options and whether we can configure per-environment policies.
3) Integration: Initial plan is direct API calls from our staging environment. If performance necessitates, we may switch to an intermediate SFTP batch for large bulks.
4) GDPR: Not in scope for the pilot (US-only clinics), but we may expand to EU centers next year and will need data-subject handling then.
5) Reviewers & timeline: Security reviewer is Mark Klein (mark.klein@clearbridgemed.com); target to have SIG answers back by Nov 24 so we can proceed with a pilot early Dec.

I’ll work with Tech Ops to prefill the spreadsheet and will return it with our answers/owners.

Best,
Danielle Moore
Director, Product Integrations
ClearBridge Medical
Danielle.Moore@clearbridgemed.com

Attachments: none

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Moore <danielle.moore@clearbridgemed.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — data-retention & integration clarifying items

Thanks Danielle — tagging answers from Redwood's side and a couple of clarifying asks for scoping: 

Redwood posture (short):
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope; we can provide the report under NDA.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows and will sign a BAA for PHI processing. Our platform supports per-tenant data retention policies.

Clarifying asks (to confirm scope):
A) For PHI: can you confirm which specific fields you consider PHI for this pilot (e.g., MRN, full name, DOB, SSN, clinical notes)? Specifics help us mark required controls.
B) Retention enforcement: is the 90/365 split a hard requirement, or would a 90-day default with a case-by-case export option suffice for pilot? We want to know if policy enforcement (automatic deletion) is required or if deletion on request is acceptable.
C) Integration security: with direct API calls, will you use mutual TLS or API keys behind your VPC? If you plan to use our Private deployment (VPC) for isolating traffic, say so now so we can include deployment notes in the SIG.

I’ve attached our prefilled SIG workbook (covering the sections we can answer immediately). Monica — I’ll need you to surface the expected evidence (e.g., encryption config screenshots, SOC2 report link) once ClearBridge confirms the PHI fields.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx (prefilled - security)

From: Tech Ops <techops@clearbridgemed.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Moore <danielle.moore@clearbridgemed.com>, Mark Klein <mark.klein@clearbridgemed.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — data-retention & integration clarifying items

Hi Neha/Jasmine — attaching our completed prefills and answers for the initial sections we own. We confirmed PHI fields for the pilot: MRN, full name, DOB, clinical notes. We will need a signed BAA prior to any PHI exchange.

Retention: we can accept Redwood’s 90-day automatic deletion for logs/transcripts and will request exports of generated outputs on a case-by-case basis (no hard 365-day retention required initially).

Integration: staging will call Redwood via API keys behind our VPC; mutual TLS is not required for the pilot but we may request it in production.

Target: we’d like Redwoods’ security team to review the attached and confirm next steps (evidence map + SOC2 NDA). Our preferred timeline remains Nov 24 for initial sign-off.

Thanks,
Tech Ops (ClearBridge Medical)

Attachments: CBM-SIG-prefill.xlsx (completed)
